title: Packed colour/core interpretation performance with unchanged 0.6.1 fidelity
scope: Raster preparation/interpreted vector fidelity, machine regressions and performance are separate gates. No new colour recovery, JPEG tolerance, segmentation or sewout claims in 0.6.2.

methodology.source: Exact main dc8081d and previous 97f6035 git archives; final 36-file candidate copy with per-file source manifest. All 78 source hashes equal across phases.
methodology.quality: Output XML hashes and independently rendered native viewBox categorical masks are separate. resvg dimensions forced to integer px to avoid decimal mm aspect-ratio rounding. The 29 known SVG-source truth masks are projected to rendered label centres; Lab deltaE<=14 matches declared paints. These post-vector metrics differ from the preceding report’s pre-trace bitmap metrics and must not be compared as the same measurement.
methodology.performance: Fresh runs of all three sources sequentially, after Python/frontend gates finished and root paused UI QA. One warm-up then seven measured preparations per isolated source subprocess. No topology, quality masks or extra resvg work in timed runs. p50/p95 per stage and total. Pilot runs under concurrent tests discarded. OS background activity remains uncontrolled; no universal throughput guarantee.
methodology.memory: Whole-process resource.ru_maxrss, macOS bytes, includes imports/native arrays/warm-up. Not per-stage incremental allocations. Memory improvements are not uniform across small controls.
methodology.machine: Seven reference inputs compare commands/threads/PES/DST/previews and source-versus-frozen interpreted SVG. Four additional control inputs decode machine outputs and compare stitch counts, finite coordinates, colour changes and bounds.

limits.fidelity_unchanged: 0.6.2 retains all previous successes and unresolved cases. Seven known JPEG accents remain absent. Fourteen strict source-core ledgers remain unresolved, exactly as in 0.6.1.
limits.xml_vs_labels: All 78 SVG files differ from main due to serialized XML layout; 46 rendered palettes/masks/physical canvases are exactly the same. No XML-format difference is presented as a quality improvement.
limits.falcon_metadata: Versus main, Falcon’s unselected fill candidate metrics differ slightly (spill/missing/jump length). Actual selected commands, threads, PES/DST and preview are equal; current versus previous diagnostics and decisions are equal.
limits.continuing_cost: Union Jack 1.356 s median remains slower than main 0.600 s, while improving previous 1.711 s. Preserving source paint details incurs a measured cost.
limits.small_features: Recovering image counter/detail geometry does not guarantee that a detail is physically sewable at the selected scale. Union Jack retains the pre-existing 58 omitted tiny regions.
limits.validation: Machine decoding and preserved exports are not Brother manufacturer validation or textile sewout tests.

reproduction.portable_script: scripts/benchmark_interpretation.py; committed benchmark with separate quality/performance modes and no added dependency.
reproduction.corpus78: Ignored local corpus and hashed inputs under output/engine-consolidation/paint-performance/corpus.json. Real fixtures are local user inputs; the seven portable synthetic fixtures require none.
reproduction.proof_status: Product snapshots, real input sources and full-corpus proof scripts are ignored local artifacts. The portable benchmark and this compact report are tracked in the repository.
reproduction.reference_note: Convenience commands resolve main at execution and record its SHA. Use the pinned refs and candidate snapshot to reproduce these historical comparisons after main advances.
reproduction.portable_root_validation: Seven generated fixtures across main dc8081d, previous 97f6035 and current 0.6.2: zero errors, exact previous SVG/render/diagnostics; main narrow counter absent, previous/current preserved. Fully transparent input errors remain visible and are never marked as equivalent successful renders. Nonempty output directories are rejected before any source/fixture write; nonexistent source roots and output inside source are rejected.

portable_smoke.case_name_validation: Unique nonempty basenames; dot/parent/separator/NULL rejected. Unmatched --names selection exits2.
